claims: C1 the rest of the document is a set of direct instructions to the model
C2 the document begins with foundational definitions used throughout the document
C3 the document then describes the chain of command, which governs how the model prioritizes and reconciles multiple instructions
C4 the remaining sections cover specific principles that guide the model's behavior

concepts.name: direct_instruction
concepts.gloss: a statement in the document that directly instructs the model on how to behave

concepts.name: foundational_definition
concepts.gloss: a definition at the beginning of the document that is used throughout the document

concepts.name: chain_of_command_principle
concepts.gloss: the principle that instructions with higher authority override those with lower authority, designed to maximize steerability and control
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the node's NEEDS contract assigns (mechanical licence correction under DECISION_licence_textual.md, 2026-08-16)

concepts.name: document_section
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of sections of the document, so a class of document sections is needed to express the ordering claims

concepts.name: section_order
concepts.gloss: section S1 comes before section S2 in the document
concepts.inference: the clause describes the document as beginning with definitions, then chain of command, then principles; expressing that ordering requires a before-relation between sections

concepts.name: governs_prioritization
concepts.gloss: the chain of command description governs how the model should prioritize and reconcile multiple instructions

concepts.name: behavior_guiding_principle
concepts.gloss: a specific principle in the remaining sections that guides the model's behavior
